body: P1 release concern, P2 recovery defect. cps/user_library.py:347-407 commits per-account mode/role changes before persisting snapshot_json at396. Simulated stop after real set_library_mode commit, close/reopen file-backed SQLite session: account personal=True,browse_global=True, intro not_enabled,snapshot=None. Retry then Undo leaves bothTrue although both were originallyFalse. Two independent probes confirm durable state, not only in-memory rollback. Persist immutable original snapshot before first account commit and resume partial work idempotently. Main1ec1bfe677 audit2026-09-08.

resolution.note: Fixed by durable pre-write restore point, atomic per-account mode/completion receipt and cross-process enable/undo exclusion. File-backed restart test seen red on 1c4f7c52ab, green after fix. tests/unit/test_my_library_enable_recovery.py.

title: Interrupted My Library bulk enable loses the original Undo snapshot
